item.title: Four Killed in Multi-Vehicle Crash on Jammu–Srinagar Highway
item.description: Jammu,Jan 27: At least four people were killed in a road accident on the Jammu–Srinagar National Highway (NH-44) near Jakhani Chowk in Udhampur district on Tuesday, officials said. According to officials, the accident involved a bus, a four-wheeler and a motorcycle. The collision left four persons dead on the spot, while details regarding injuries are yet to be confirmed. item.title: Deputy CM announces Ban on Mining near Bridges
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 27: Deputy Chief Minister Surinder Choudhary on Tuesday announced a blanket ban on mining activities near bridges, following reports of damage to a bridge in the Chadoora area of Budgam district allegedly caused by illegal mining. item.title: Fresh snowfall in Kashmir; Srinagar-Jammu highway closed for traffic
item.description: Srinagar: Kashmir was draped in white on Tuesday after the valley received fresh snowfall which led to closure of the Srinagar-Jammu national highway and disrupted flight operations. Most parts of Kashmir received fresh overnight snowfall as a western disturbance affected the region. The plains of the valley, including Srinagar, recorded light to moderate snow, while the higher reaches received moderate to heavy falls. item.description: Srinagar: All flights to and from Srinagar International Airport were cancelled on Tuesday due to snowfall in Kashmir, officials said. “Due to adverse weather conditions and continuous snowfall in Srinagar, the runway is currently not available for safe aircraft operations. item.title: J-K speaker convenes all-party meeting ahead of Budget Session on Feb 2
item.description: Jammu: An all-parties meeting will be convened ahead of the Jammu and Kashmir Assembly’s Budget Session, scheduled to begin next month, Speaker Abdul Rahim Rather said on Tuesday, urging legislators to make effective use of the proceedings by raising public issues for redressal. item.title: CRPF jawan among four dead in road crash in JK’s Udhampur
item.description: Jammu, Jan 27 (PTI) Four people, including a CRPF jawan, were killed and a woman injured when a bus hit a parked load carrier and a motorcycle in Jammu and Kashmir’s Udhampur district on Tuesday, officials said. The accident occurred near Jakhani-Chenani area on Jammu-Srinagar national highway around 11 am. item.title: Flights Resume as Snow Cleared at Srinagar Airport
item.description: Srinagar, Jan 28: Flight operations at Srinagar International Airport resumed on Wednesday, a day after heavy snowfall forced the cancellation of all services, officials said. The first flight landed at 9:25 am, and authorities expect normal operations to continue throughout the day if weather conditions remain stable. “The runway, taxiway, and apron have been cleared of snow and are ready for use,” the Airport Authority of India (AAI) said in a statement. item.title: 28-Year-Old man dies of Suffocation inside Vehicle in South Kashmir
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 28: A 28-year-old man died of suffocation inside his Tata Mobile load carrier at District Hospital Kulgam in south Kashmir on Wednesday morning, officials said. An official said that the deceased has been identified as Mashooq Ahmad Mir, son of Mohammad Yousuf Mir, a resident of Koulpora, Kulgam.
